title: HOO radical scavenging activity of curcumin I and III in physiological conditions: a theoretical investigation on the influence of acid–base equilibrium and tautomerism
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5649-5664

Thermodynamics and kinetics of HOO radical scavenging reactions of Cur-I and Cur-III were investigated in water and PEA solutions, considering acid–base equilibrium and tautomerism effects.
